sources.title: eousphoros/persona_lambda_27b_v8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: “Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}.” For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.

sources.snippet: This is an experimental blockwise-FP8 derivative of eousphoros/qwen3.8-27b-yarn4-mixed-kl-128k-r1-iter137. The source model merges a LoRA/direct-normalization calibration into Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B for static YaRN with a factor of 4.0.
